results.summary_before: This design counts the number of digital pulses occurring within a time interval across four input channels. The counts are periodically output using a serial output. It is intended for low-power wake-up sensor interfaces, acoustic event detection, non-destructive testing, and particle counting. The design is a generic pulse-counting digital building block.
results.summary: This design computes the Collatz orbit of an 8-bit input number. It outputs the number of iterations required to reach 1 and a status bit indicating whether the calculation is in progress or complete. Once the process is finished, the circuit keeps the iteration count indefinitely so that it can be checked. Testing requires a clock signal, an 8-bit input number, and the active-low rst_n signal to start the iterations.
